summary: Iter 20: Ran the ready-made pytest suite for outbound voicemail/AMD/status webhook and verified Privacy page + CalendarsTab in-app disclosure. 14/15 backend tests pass. One CRITICAL bug found: the /status webhook still OVERWRITES a prior voicemail flag with 'answered' when Twilio posts CallStatus=completed without AnsweredBy (the exact bug the fix was supposed to prevent). Frontend Privacy page and CalendarsTab disclosure are perfect.

critical.issue: Voicemail preservation NOT working. After AMD sets outcome='voicemail', posting CallStatus=completed with no AnsweredBy flips outcome to 'answered'. See outbound_call_routes.py line 742: `outcome = "voicemail" if answered_by.startswith("machine") else "answered"` — this unconditionally computes outcome from AnsweredBy of the CURRENT request and doesn't read the existing campaign_calls doc to preserve a prior voicemail flag. Test test_status_completed_preserves_voicemail_no_ai_summary asserts outcome stays 'voicemail' but got 'answered'. This is the primary bug the iter20 change was supposed to fix. It also risks triggering _generate_call_summary (AI cost) for actual voicemails.

action_items: FIX outbound_call_routes.py::outbound_status voicemail preservation. Before computing outcome on 'completed', read the existing campaign_calls doc; if its outcome is already 'voicemail', preserve it (do NOT overwrite to 'answered') and skip AI-summary enqueue. Example fix around line 741-742: `existing = await _s.db.campaign_calls.find_one({'id': call_id}, {'outcome': 1}); prior = (existing or {}).get('outcome'); if prior == 'voicemail': outcome = 'voicemail' else: outcome = 'voicemail' if answered_by.startswith('machine') else 'answered'`. Also gate the `if outcome == 'answered'` block so it does not run when prior was voicemail.
critical_code_review_comments: outbound_call_routes.py line 742: outcome is computed purely from the current webhook's AnsweredBy field, ignoring the DB. This defeats the whole point of the async AMD hangup fix — because the real Twilio 'completed' callback usually arrives WITHOUT AnsweredBy after AMD hung up, the voicemail flag gets clobbered every time.

outbound_call_routes.py line 794: `if outcome == 'answered': asyncio.create_task(_generate_call_summary(call_id))` — because of the bug above, this will fire for real voicemails too, wasting LLM tokens. Fix by preserving voicemail as noted.

rca of the issue: Root cause: outbound_status() in /app/backend/outbound_call_routes.py (lines 741-755) computes `outcome` solely from the incoming form's AnsweredBy. When Twilio invokes AMD first, the AMD webhook correctly stamps outcome='voicemail' on campaign_calls. Then Twilio's regular status callback fires with CallStatus=completed but usually WITHOUT AnsweredBy (the field only appears on the AMD webhook). Because the code has no read-modify-write against the existing outcome, it re-computes to 'answered' and $set-overwrites the voicemail. Reproduction: (1) insert campaign_calls doc, (2) POST /amd/{id} AnsweredBy=machine_start → outcome=voicemail (correct), (3) POST /status/{id} CallStatus=completed CallDuration=8 → outcome flips to answered (BUG). Mitigation: before assigning outcome in the 'completed' branch, look up the existing campaign_calls doc; if its outcome is already 'voicemail', keep it and also skip the _generate_call_summary AI task.
